parameters.query:
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_waitlist_offers (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    waitlist_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES appointment_waitlist(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    doctor_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES doctors(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    offer_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    offered_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    offered_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'offered'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'offered',
                'accepted',
                'declined',
                'expired',
                'cancelled'
            )
        ),

    offered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    responded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    response_note TEXT,

    source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'assistant',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CHECK (offered_ends_at > offered_starts_at),
    CHECK (expires_at > offered_at)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_waitlist_active_offer
    ON appointment_waitlist_offers(waitlist_id)
    WHERE status = 'offered';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_doctor_exact_active_offer
    ON appointment_waitlist_offers(
        doctor_id,
        offered_starts_at,
        offered_ends_at
    )
    WHERE status = 'offered';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_waitlist_offers_expiry
    ON appointment_waitlist_offers(
        status,
        expires_at
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_waitlist_offers_token
    ON appointment_waitlist_offers(offer_token);

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار پیشنهاد زمان آزاد به بیماران لیست انتظار ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `appointment_waitlist_offers` را ایجاد می‌کند.

هر پیشنهاد شامل بیمار، زمان پیشنهادی، زمان انقضا، وضعیت پاسخ و یک توکن یکتا است.

پس از اجرای موفق، Workflow را غیرفعال نگه دار.
